HAND SCALE / TECHNIQUE

Crystal gazing.

Light, reflections and an attentive gaze.

◇FIELD NOTE / 18
THE OBSERVATION

Look closely.

Crystal gazing, also called crystallomancy, uses a crystal or polished sphere as a focus for symbolic observation. Historical objects such as John Dee's crystal provide a material point of reference for the practice.

Explore hand scale ↗
A STARTING PROTOCOL

Make a record.

Record the object, lighting, background and approximate duration. Describe reflections and visible forms before writing any associations. Keep the original observation alongside the symbolic reading.

Keep the original observation, the method and any interpretation together in the record.
